description: David will be at the Ryegate Transfer station on Saturday, June 6 from 10 till noon. This is an opportunity to meet David, who is running for the VT House. Introduce yourself, ask questions, and share the issues and concerns that matter most to you. Stop by, grab a donut and say hello.

title: Donuts with David at the Dump, June 6 - Tucker for Vermont
